In the confirmation period the account would have made -6.4% against +7.1% for buy and hold scaled to the same time in the market and +37.1% for plain buy and hold; a job in 100% of symbol-weeks, weekly difference to the time-matched benchmark -0.498% (95% range -0.730 to -0.266), 1068 round trips, 4.27% of the account in costs.

Option 1: drop to no job: FAILS (its picks were clearly worse than time-matched buy and hold in the design period; its picks were clearly worse than time-matched buy and hold in the confirmation period). In the confirmation period the account would have made -4.7% against +4.2% for buy and hold scaled to the same time in the market and +37.1% for plain buy and hold; a job in 56% of symbol-weeks, weekly difference to the time-matched benchmark -0.334% (95% range -0.544 to -0.123), 749 round trips, 3.00% of the account in costs.

Option 2: vs matched buy and hold: FAILS (it kept a job with a negative score for 15 weeks in a row in the design period (allowed: 2); its picks were clearly worse than time-matched buy and hold in the confirmation period; it kept a job with a negative score for 8 weeks in a row in the confirmation period (allowed: 2)). In the confirmation period the account would have made -3.9% against +6.2% for buy and hold scaled to the same time in the market and +37.1% for plain buy and hold; a job in 100% of symbol-weeks, weekly difference to the time-matched benchmark -0.372% (95% range -0.610 to -0.133), 929 round trips, 3.72% of the account in costs.

Options 1 + 2: FAILS (its picks were clearly worse than time-matched buy and hold in the design period). In the confirmation period the account would have made -4.6% against +0.6% for buy and hold scaled to the same time in the market and +37.1% for plain buy and hold; a job in 55% of symbol-weeks, weekly difference to the time-matched benchmark -0.192% (95% range -0.392 to +0.007), 498 round trips, 1.99% of the account in costs.

Options 1 + 2 + edge per trade (2x): FAILS (its picks were clearly worse than time-matched buy and hold in the design period; its picks were clearly worse than time-matched buy and hold in the confirmation period). In the confirmation period the account would have made -3.7% against +1.2% for buy and hold scaled to the same time in the market and +37.1% for plain buy and hold; a job in 59% of symbol-weeks, weekly difference to the time-matched benchmark -0.183% (95% range -0.366 to -0.001), 554 round trips, 2.22% of the account in costs.
With 1 bp per side for SPY and QQQ instead of 2, no version's pass/fail changes.

Does the score predict the next week (rank correlation, 95% range; 0 = no link)? Today (all switches off): -0.012 (-0.068 to +0.040); Option 1: drop to no job: -0.012 (-0.068 to +0.040); Option 2: vs matched buy and hold: +0.003 (-0.049 to +0.056); Options 1 + 2: +0.003 (-0.049 to +0.056); Options 1 + 2 + edge per trade (2x): -0.037 (-0.100 to +0.028).
300 comparisons were made (every version against every benchmark and per symbol, per period and cost level); about 8 would look clearly better by luck alone, and 2 did.
